$comment: Trust-registry SNAPSHOT carried inline so the commitment bundle verifies with zero network access (spec §8.8.1 self-contained serialization, §9.4). It deliberately does NOT contain this POC's throwaway signing key: the expected verdict is unknown_key, and a registry that made this node green would defeat the point. Copied verbatim from the poc/rulespec-interop fixture so the two POCs share one snapshot.

statusSemantics.active: Valid for signing new packages and for verification.
statusSemantics.deprecated: Cannot sign new packages. Signatures are valid for verification only when the package's Rekor integratedTime precedes deprecatedAt.
statusSemantics.revoked: Never valid — any signature is treated as suspect regardless of when the package was integrated.
